subject: Aaron Olapade School Committee Platform
overview: Aaron Olapade presents his background as a Medford Public Schools graduate and outlines his platform for a School Committee candidacy. His priorities include improving school safety and mental health, advancing equity and inclusion, and increasing support for educators.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Biography
items.summary: Aaron Olapade introduces himself as a candidate for School Committee, detailing his history as a Medford High School graduate and his professional experience in the state legislature.

items.title: Priority One: Safety and Support
items.summary: Olapade advocates for improved school infrastructure, adequate budgeting, and expanded mental health resources to create a supportive learning environment.

items.title: Priority Two: Equity and Inclusion
items.summary: The candidate proposes making extracurricular activities more accessible and diversifying the teaching staff to foster an anti-racist and inclusive district culture.

items.title: Priority Three: Educator Support and Collaboration
items.summary: The platform includes a commitment to fair compensation for staff and the creation of formal partnerships between schools and community organizations.

items.title: Conclusion and Campaign Appeal
items.summary: Olapade concludes by requesting voter support and financial contributions for his campaign.
